about_short_description.short_description: Facet is a computer software company that provides artists and engineers, aiming to redefine and humanize the creative process.

product.name: Generative Canvas
product.description: A real-time collaborative AI image generation tool that allows users to spatially arrange image elements and control prompts for precise image creation.

product.name: Photo Editor
product.description: An AI-native, collaborative photo editing tool that supports content-aware editing, batch processing, automasking, and style transfer for streamlined workflows.

product.name: Custom Models
product.description: A feature that allows users to train personalized AI models using their own images to generate assets matching specific aesthetics and concepts.

product.name: ArtGPT
product.description: An AI conversational assistant that helps users generate and refine images through natural dialogue with various creative personas.

product.name: Facet.space Community Platform
product.description: An online community platform where users can share, remix, and explore image editing sessions and styles created by other creatives.
